rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for someone highly skilled and experienced at a practical task.

example.jyutping: keoi5 zou6 muk6 gung1 hou2 suk6 sau2

rows.note: Use this casual praise when emphasizing that someone is very capable, without specifically highlighting training or experience.

example.english: You’re really adept—you fixed the air conditioner so quickly.
example.traditional: 你咁快就整好部冷氣，真係好叻喎。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam3 faai3 zau6 zing2 hou2 bou6 laang5 hei3 zan1 hai6 hou2 lek1 wo3

rows.note: Use this for thorough mastery of a named subject, skill, language, or field, especially in more formal contexts.

example.english: They are adept in several foreign languages.
example.jyutping: keoi5 zing1 tung1 gei2 zung2 ngoi6 jyu5
